data.headline: Asbury Park agenda shows seven Waterfront entitlement references

claims.text: The September 9 City Council agenda recorded seven items mentioning Block 3801, 320 Asbury Avenue, or the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: 2026-22 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park Authorizing The Execution Of A Financial Agreement With PHM Drift at Asbury Park Urban Renewal LLC Concerning Property Located At Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area

claims.text: STHO’s stated strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators while meeting its redevelopment agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.

claims.text: STHO reported an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
